courses.title: Clear Stream Tai Chi weekly class on Zoom
courses.description: A live online class with Vince Sauter every Wednesday morning at 9:30 am (US Eastern), held on Zoom only. Sessions combine qigong and Tai Chi Easy forms with balance and breath practice, and suit newcomers as well as regular students. Payment is by donation, at whatever amount students feel the classes are worth.

courses.title: Discover Flow Through Silk Reeling
courses.description: A weekend workshop at the Omega Institute in Rhinebeck, New York, taught by Vince Sauter with fellow senior Tai Chi Easy teacher Charlessa Thatcher. It covers Yang-style tai chi, silk reeling, tai chi walking, breathwork and balance exercises, building up the forms one step at a time. Suitable for complete beginners and for those who have found tai chi hard to connect with; on-campus accommodation with meals is booked separately, or guests can attend as commuters.

free_resources.title: 30 Minute Qigong and Tai Chi class series
free_resources.description: A free nine-session video course on Vince Sauter's site, each lesson around half an hour. It starts with posture and alignment and the Vitality Method qigong set, then adds breath work and the five Tai Chi Easy forms one at a time, finishing with the walking five form. The aim is to leave students able to build a practice of their own.

free_resources.title: 5 Element Forms
free_resources.description: A free set of five short qigong videos, one for each element of the Chinese seasonal cycle: water, wood, fire, earth and metal. Each is paired with its season, so the practice can change through the year.
